name: BambooHR Thomas2Go Micro-Kitchen & Smart Cooler: Hard-Boiled Eggs, String Cheese, Yogurt & Pretzels
brandOrRestaurant: Thomas2Go / Thomas Cuisine Micro-Kitchen at BambooHR (Lindon / Draper, UT)
whyItWorks: Safe office micro-kitchen staples when you need a quick snack between meetings: peeled 2-pack hard-boiled eggs, aged cheddar/mozzarella string cheese, ripe bananas, pretzels, and Greek yogurt.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Grab peeled hard-boiled eggs, string cheese, a banana, or plain pretzels from the cooler; if eating a yogurt parfait, eat the yogurt and leave the nutty/seeded granola layer behind.
watchOuts: Skip the raw crudité veggie cups, trail mix, and seeded granola layers
